$comment: Generated by `cargo xtask schemas` from dudes-proto; contract v1. Do not edit.

AgentId.description: AgentId: a ULID (26 characters of Crockford base32).

Provenance.description:
Provenance of an event or a predicate result.

Ordered: `Observed > Inferred`. `Done` requires an `Observed` predicate result; an `Inferred`
event may raise a breaker rung but may never be the sole cause of `Stop` or `Done`
(invariant 3).

oneOf.description:
The daemon did not see it: attached-mode PTY silence, a child that vanished between
daemon restarts, an agent's self-report. Evidence, never a verdict.

The daemon saw it: a process exit code, a command it ran, a hash it computed, a board
state it holds, a verifier verdict it received.

Timestamp.description: UTC milliseconds since the Unix epoch. An integer so it sorts, diffs and reads in `jq`.

Tokens.description: A token count. Arithmetic saturates rather than wrapping.

Usage.description:
What one turn (or one event) consumed.

Every field defaults so a record written before a field existed still reads. `usd` is absent
when the provider reports tokens but not cost; the budget gate then prices tokens itself or,
with no usage source at all, refuses admission.

cache_creation.description: Prompt tokens written to the vendor's prompt cache.

cache_read.description: Prompt tokens read from the vendor's prompt cache.

input.description: Prompt tokens that were not served from a cache.

usd.description: Cost as the vendor reported it, if it did.

Usd.description:
US dollars in micro-dollars (`1_000_000` = `$1`). Never negative: nothing in the contract
models a refund, so a cost below zero is a vendor bug and is refused at the boundary by
[`Usd::try_from_micros`] rather than subtracted from a spend. Arithmetic saturates rather than
wrapping.

description: Something a provider told the daemon, normalised.

oneOf.description:
The vendor started or resumed a session. Informational: nothing waits on it, it raises
no rung and never causes `Done`, `Stop` or `Wait`; the vendor's source, session id and
model are in `raw`.

The vendor ended a session. Fires on error exits where `TurnEnd` does not (Claude Code
2.1.239, `--max-turns` / `--max-budget-usd` runs); in managed mode the process exit is
still the turn boundary.
A prompt was submitted to the model.
A tool is about to run; the reply may deny it.

The model finished a turn (a vendor `Stop`). Attached mode only: in managed mode the
process exit is the `Observed` turn end and the stream's final message is carried on
`TurnEnded`.

last_message.description: The model's final message, when the vendor provides it.

oneOf.description: The vendor raised a notification (permission prompt, idle prompt, …).
Token and cost usage the vendor reported.

**This variant has no producer and no consumer**.

An agent asks by calling `agent.ask`, which becomes `Command::Ask` and journals
`Record::HumanQuestion` directly; the supervisor's hook path no longer reads this kind,
and no adapter emits one. The agent-ask path refuses the only thing that could feed it — a
classification of the agent's own output — so a branch here would be a second, weaker
emitter beside the strong one, which is how the strong one gets bypassed.

It stays declared because the variant is schema surface (`schemas/` is generated from this
crate) and removing it would change the generated schema.

agent.description:
The agent whose process produced it (from the hook token or the child table, never from
the payload).

provenance.description:
`Observed` for anything the daemon's own process host or hook server delivered;
`Inferred` for anything derived from silence or self-report.

raw.description: The vendor's JSON, verbatim, when there was one.
